s: A company is migrating a containerized Kubernetes app with manifest files to AWS. What is the easiest migration path?
o: Amazon EKSwith managed node groups and Aurora
Rebuild Kubernetes cluster on EC2 manually

w.y: The workload already runs on Kubernetes with manifest files, so the easiest path is managed Kubernetes. Amazon EKS with managed node groups runs the existing manifests with few changes.

o.A: App Runner does not run Kubernetes manifests.
o.B: Correct: EKS runs the existing Kubernetes manifests on managed node groups.
